title: Money into envelopes
description: Digital envelopes with no bank connection. You allocate money to purposes, record expenses and see the history of top-ups and transfers between envelopes.

blocks.text: Yearly insurance and monthly rent arrive at different frequencies. Envelopes help divide money by purpose in your head, but they have to allow for that difference. One reviewer singles out support for irregular expenses.

quote.text: This was the only app I found that grasps and embraces that not all expenses are monthly. Some might be once a year, twice a year, or four times a year. And some expenses just happen when they happen, like repairs or illness.

blocks.text: For each envelope, keep the goal, the chosen top-up schedule and the amounts actually put in. Show a transfer between envelopes as a reallocation, not as new income. Explain separately how the virtual amounts relate to real accounts.

Test a yearly payment, an unplanned expense and a transfer of money between goals. The person should understand how much has been allocated and where it actually sits. The way it is stored and shared access are worth choosing according to how they work.
